verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a case-management review queue: alerts can be prioritised, filtered and decided. Transactions run through transaction monitoring that produces cases and alerts, and each case has an audit trail. However, the evidence does not show the queue presenting full context (customer history, risk signals, similar cases) alongside a flagged transaction. missing for 10: evidence of customer history shown in the review view, surfaced signals/explanations per alert, similar-case retrieval, consistency aids, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, flagged transactions land in a review queue that shows the full context — customer history, signals, similar cases — so I can decide quickly and consistently

citations.quote: Its case management solution allows you to prioritise and review risk alerts raised during onboarding and ongoing monitoring.
Filter cases by customer risk, case stage, who the case is assigned to, or when it was created.
Creates a transaction and executes our payment screening and transaction monitoring processes.
They can then select a case decision of ‘no risk detected’, ‘risk detected- accepted’ and ‘risk detected- offboard’.
Returns the audit log trail for a case.
